Number of tractor T5 sold by both companies is how much percent more than the number of tractor T2 sold by both companies?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of tractor T5 sold by both companies = 110 + 150

⇒ 260

Number of tractor T2 sold by both companies = 40 + 50

⇒ 90

Difference = 260 - 90

⇒ 170

Required % = (170/90) × 100

⇒ 188.88%

**∴ The required answer is 188.88%.**
